note: The owner's rules in force for the XAUUSD system, each with its source. Constitutional rules change only by a reviewed PR or an owner-approved amendment; operational rules follow the measured system through the Knowledge Council and Cerebrum (doctrine_protocol). Retired rules are kept for history and are never indexed.

rules.rule: No Worker places an order or can read a broker credential. Trades happen only on the owner's own MetaTrader 5 terminal: the owner's EA executes the decision it reads from the signal API, or the Omega bridge executes what Omega plans and sizes from the owner's risk setting, at most 10% of equity per trade. Omega plans nothing unless both its switch and its page toggle are on, a real account also needs the typed LIVE arm, a kill closes the positions, and the EA and the Omega executor never run on the same account. Aether, the kernel and learned knowledge stay advisory.

rules.rule: When the evidence is missing the answer is WAIT, never a guess. A room without a usable closed candle or without its quorum decides WAIT. The Decision Engine gives WAIT when any guardrail fails; when the council fails or answers invalidly, the strategy engine's decision stands only if its side passes every guardrail, otherwise WAIT. A closed market is always WAIT.

rules.rule: No change to an engine parameter, a prompt or a knowledge item is promoted automatically: candidates run in shadow, are judged by outcome scoring with a significance test, and the owner approves a separate promotion PR. Two things change without an operator: the room quorum weighting (weighting_auto) and operational doctrine amendments inside their hard bounds that Cerebrum executed (doctrine_protocol).

rules.rule: The doctrine follows the measured system through the Knowledge Council. Once a day its Nexus, Omega and Aether seats compare every rule's anchored facts with what the running system reports; a difference the reporting seat measured twice, at least 45 minutes apart, and the Aether seat validated, is proposed to the Cerebrum consensus. Cerebrum votes and executes it: an operational fact inside its hard bounds after the vote, anything else after one owner approval. Aether applies only amendments Cerebrum executed and folds them into the canon by a reviewed PR. No seat changes the doctrine by itself.

rules.rule: The Decision Engine is the single decision. At every 15m close one AI council, the only reader across the timeframes, chooses BUY, SELL or WAIT from witnesses that each judge from their own data, weighted D1 room 0.1263, 4H room 0.1263, 1H room 0.1263, 15m room 0.0947, News Daily 0.0632, Macro War Room 0.0315, strategy engine 0.0632, key levels 0.0395, regime 0.0395, cross-timeframe trend 0.0395, macro drivers 0.0237, session 0.02, economic calendar inside a release's horizon 0.08, strategy agents' consensus 0.1263; a missing or stale witness drops out and the rest renormalise. It decides inside deterministic guardrails it cannot break (market_open, fresh, quorum, no_veto, levels, reward, room, confidence); a BUY or SELL that breaks one becomes WAIT. Prices come only from the Key Level Agent's plan, never from a model. Its decision feeds the EA, Omega, Telegram, the Signal Ledger and Nexus.

It decides inside deterministic guardrails it cannot break ({decision.guardrails}); a BUY or SELL that breaks one becomes WAIT. Prices come only from the Key Level Agent's plan, never from a model. rules.rule: The Decision Engine's BUY or SELL needs, in the trading mode in force: more than the mode's quorum of the witnesses' weight on its side (scalp 45%, intraday 50%, swing 60%, range 50%), or a lean of at least the mode's lean (scalp 0.1, intraday 0.15, swing 0.2, range 0.15) with more weight than the other side; no veto; a plan from the key levels paying at least the mode's reward to its target (intraday 1.5R, swing 2R, range 1.5R; in the scalp mode the target is the nearest key level ahead, with no reward-to-risk minimum); room to move, with the nearest key zones below and above price at least the trading mode's room apart, in 1H average ranges (scalp 1, intraday 1, swing 1, range 1; the learning protocol moves each between 0.5 and 1.5); and a confidence of at least 0.4.

rules.rule: The rooms decide by their own quorum, without a confirmation gate, and so does the Decision Engine (its confirmation gate is off): the confirmation candle is the trigger of a market order (prophet_candle_for_market_orders_broker_5m). A market order waits for a broker 5m Prophet confirmation on its side within 3 broker 5m bars after the decision, once the broker's 5m lane is ready and fresh; until then, or while it is stale, a verified 5m or a 15m Prophet confirmation on its side, the one the decision recorded or one printed since. A TradingView 5m confirmation counts only while the 5m Prophet implementation is parity-approved; the broker's 5m is not parity-verified (its bars differ from OANDA's by the basis). A limit order at the key level waits only for price.

rules.rule: The H1 decision is the quorum of the 1H War Room: BUY or SELL only when the moderator concluded it and more than the room's quorum share (default 50%, tuned by weighting_auto) of the weight of the agents who spoke holds the matching bias, with prices from the 1H plan; otherwise WAIT. Indicator signals are the agents' arguments, never gates or vetoes. The H1 decision is one witness of the Decision Engine; it drives the EA and Telegram only while the Decision Engine is off.

rules.rule: Every timeframe's room is independent: its agents read only that timeframe's own data, never another timeframe's room, desk or decision and never another agent; the Consensus Discussion stays inside each timeframe over an anonymous bus, and every answer names the metrics it decided from, never an agent. Only the Decision Engine's council reads across the timeframes.

rules.rule: A High-impact USD event, from 120 minutes before to 30 minutes after it, is a caution in the decision, never a forced WAIT; the EA and Omega make no new entry in that window. After a release with its value, the Calendar Agent's bias follows the surprise within the event's learned horizon.

rules.rule: Omega opens at most once per signal, before it expires and within 10 minutes of the decision, outside the event blackout and the daily rollover quarantine (21:55-22:15 UTC), at a spread of at most 60 points, with fewer open positions than the account profile allows (Safe 1, Conservative 2, Aggressive 2, Custom 2) and above the profile's daily loss limit (Safe 3%, Conservative 6%, Aggressive 6%, Custom 6%) of the day's starting balance. It risks the profile's share of equity at the stop (Safe 1%, Conservative 2%, Aggressive 3%, Custom 3%), the smaller of the profile's cap and the setting, and keeps the plan's distances from the broker's own price; a position against the signal is closed. A new entry's lot is capped to what the day can still lose (the equity above the daily loss floor less the open positions' loss at their stops), and a second position on a side waits until every position on that side is protected, its stop at or beyond its open price. Omega alone moves an open position's stop and target, from the key levels and the latest decision's quorum power: past a key level the stop locks a small profit and steps behind the passed levels (further back with a strong power, tighter with a weak one), near the target a strong power moves it to the next key level, and a winner is closed when the power turns strongly against it; the executor's own break-even and trailing are off.

rules.rule: The Positioning & Liquidity analyst reads two lenses, in the trading mode in force, and never opens, sizes or prices a position. Lens A, positioning from the weekly CFTC report read only after its release, is a Decision Engine witness at a share of the witness weight (scalp 0.02, intraday 0.03, swing 0.05, range 0.03; the other witnesses scale by one less that share); the crowd is stretched when managed money's net sits at or beyond the percentile (scalp 0.9, intraday 0.9, swing 0.9, range 0.9, the low side one less) among the 156 weekly nets before it, and the week's flow counts beyond its standard deviations (scalp 1, intraday 1, swing 1, range 1). Lens B, liquidity from the broker's own one-minute bars against its hour of the week, is weighed in the councils (scalp 0.4, intraday 0.3, swing 0.2, range 0.3; at 0 it is muted); a tick-volume spike is at or above the percentile (scalp 0.95, intraday 0.95, swing 0.97, range 0.95), thin liquidity at or below (scalp 0.2, intraday 0.2, swing 0.2, range 0.2), and a spread spike at the median spread times (scalp 1.8, intraday 2, swing 2.5, range 2); a sweep is searched for over minutes (scalp 60, intraday 180, swing 720, range 180), equal extremes lie within ATR multiples (scalp 0.05, intraday 0.05, swing 0.08, range 0.05), and a volume node is a profile bin at or above the percentile (scalp 0.85, intraday 0.85, swing 0.85, range 0.85) of a profile over minutes (scalp 240, intraday 1440, swing 7200, range 1440). Each lens is scored on its own readings: below a hit share of 0.45 over its last 60 readings lens A, and below 0.45 over 100 lens B, drops to the floor of its weight in every mode at once, and only a newer doctrine lifts it.

Lens B, liquidity from the broker's own one-minute bars against its hour of the week, is weighed in the councils (scalp {liquidity.council_weight_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.council_weight_intraday}, swing {liquidity.council_weight_swing}, range {liquidity.council_weight_range}; at 0 it is muted); a tick-volume spike is at or above the percentile (scalp {liquidity.spike_pctl_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.spike_pctl_intraday}, swing {liquidity.spike_pctl_swing}, range {liquidity.spike_pctl_range}), thin liquidity at or below (scalp {liquidity.thin_pctl_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.thin_pctl_intraday}, swing {liquidity.thin_pctl_swing}, range {liquidity.thin_pctl_range}), and a spread spike at the median spread times (scalp {liquidity.spread_widen_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.spread_widen_intraday}, swing {liquidity.spread_widen_swing}, range {liquidity.spread_widen_range}); a sweep is searched for over minutes (scalp {liquidity.sweep_lookback_min_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.sweep_lookback_min_intraday}, swing {liquidity.sweep_lookback_min_swing}, range {liquidity.sweep_lookback_min_range}), equal extremes lie within ATR multiples (scalp {liquidity.pool_tol_atr_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.pool_tol_atr_intraday}, swing {liquidity.pool_tol_atr_swing}, range {liquidity.pool_tol_atr_range}), and a volume node is a profile bin at or above the percentile (scalp {liquidity.hvn_pctl_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.hvn_pctl_intraday}, swing {liquidity.hvn_pctl_swing}, range {liquidity.hvn_pctl_range}) of a profile over minutes (scalp {liquidity.profile_window_min_scalp}, intraday {liquidity.profile_window_min_intraday}, swing {liquidity.profile_window_min_swing}, range {liquidity.profile_window_min_range}). Each lens is scored on its own readings: below a hit share of {positioning.score_floor} over its last {positioning.score_window} readings lens A, and below {liquidity.score_floor} over {liquidity.score_window} lens B, drops to the floor of its weight in every mode at once, and only a newer doctrine lifts it.
